cases.question: Show me whether leaving a day earlier or later would give me a better flight option.
cases.rationale: Comparing nearby departure dates is flexible-date flight search.

cases.question: The unpaid reservation you are holding for me expires soon; can I have longer to pay?
cases.rationale: The user seeks extra time on an existing unpaid hold rather than a new hold or payment.

cases.question: I need the airline to carry my surfboard as checked sports equipment.
cases.rationale: A surfboard is special sports baggage, not ordinary extra weight or an animal container.

cases.question: Arrange adjacent seats for everyone travelling in our party.
cases.rationale: The request is specifically for the party to sit together.

cases.question: I finished check-in but lost the boarding document; send me another copy.
cases.rationale: Check-in is complete and the user needs an issued boarding pass again.

cases.question: Replace the contact phone number saved on this flight reservation.
cases.rationale: The changed contact belongs to a reservation rather than a loyalty profile.

cases.question: My ticket refund application is already in; what stage has it reached?
cases.rationale: The refund request exists and only its processing status is requested.

cases.question: The flight I took last month has not earned any miles in my account; claim the missing credit.
cases.rationale: The missing miles relate to a completed flight, not a non-flight partner.

cases.question: Please register a gluten-free dietary meal request for my upcoming flight.
cases.rationale: A dietary accommodation belongs to special meals rather than a paid menu purchase.

cases.question: Online check-in keeps showing an error after I select my booking; help me get past it.
cases.rationale: An error in online check-in requires troubleshooting, not initiation of an otherwise working check-in.

cases.question: Do not open another missing-bag report; use my existing report to see where the suitcase is.
cases.rationale: An existing tracing report and a location request distinguish tracking from an initial baggage report.

cases.question: This reservation has never been paid for; release its temporary hold instead of cancelling a ticket.
cases.rationale: The explicit unpaid hold must be released through hold cancellation, not issued-ticket cancellation.

cases.question: I am keeping the same cabin and flight; only move my assigned seat to a window.
cases.rationale: Only seat assignment changes; neither cabin upgrade nor flight change is requested.

cases.question: I do not need a boarding pass; I need the receipt proving I paid for the airline ticket.
cases.rationale: The required document is a ticket-payment receipt rather than a boarding document.

cases.question: Change my loyalty name—sorry, the spelling mistake is on the passenger name on my ticket.
cases.rationale: The corrected request concerns the ticketed passenger name, not the loyalty profile.

cases.question: Cancel my paid flight—actually, keep the booking and move it to the following week.
cases.rationale: The final request is a voluntary date change of a paid booking, replacing the initial cancellation request.

cases.question: Check my refund—let me correct that, I have not applied yet; start a refund request for the unused ticket.
cases.rationale: The user corrects the assumption of an existing application and asks to initiate one.

cases.question: Book my cat on the flight—first, I only want the required dimensions for its travel container.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly defers booking and narrows the current request to pet-container requirements.

cases.question: uh find a return flight from Madrid to Rome, leaving next Monday, back Friday, one adult
cases.rationale: Constructed disfluency leaves a clear conventional return-flight search.

cases.question: can we check, check me in online for the flight tomorrow please
cases.rationale: The repetition does not introduce an error report; the user wants to start online check-in.

cases.question: my suitcase came off the belt and the wheel is, is broken off, I need to report that
cases.rationale: The returned bag is damaged, distinguishing this from missing baggage or an initial compensation application.

cases.question: how many miles have I got, um, available in my frequent flyer account
cases.rationale: Written hesitation retains a straightforward loyalty-mile balance inquiry.

cases.question: The cancellation is already confirmed; tell me the reason the airline recorded for it.
cases.rationale: The request asks why the flight was cancelled rather than whether cancellation occurred.

cases.question: Issue an official letter documenting the delay so I can attach it to another claim.
cases.rationale: The user needs evidence of disruption, not initial airline compensation or proof of completed travel.

cases.question: I paid for my own hotel during your flight cancellation; I want those hotel costs repaid.
cases.rationale: Personally paid disruption expenses require reimbursement rather than carrier-arranged accommodation.

cases.question: Cancel the award reservation I paid for entirely with miles and return any eligible miles.
cases.rationale: The explicitly mileage-funded award belongs to award cancellation rather than ordinary paid-booking cancellation.

cases.question: Move it to a different one, please.
cases.rationale: The missing referent could be a flight, seat, or another object, so prior context is essential.

cases.question: There is a problem with my ticket and I need it sorted.
cases.rationale: The message does not specify payment, passenger details, travel changes, or another ticket operation.

cases.question: I need to sort something out with my frequent flyer miles.
cases.rationale: The requested loyalty operation is unspecified and could concern balance, missing credit, expiry, or redemption.

cases.question: Choose a window seat for me and check how my existing ticket refund is progressing.
cases.rationale: Seat selection and refund tracking are two independent requests with no chosen first task.

cases.question: Buy an extra checked bag and change the contact email on my reservation.
cases.rationale: Additional baggage purchase and reservation-contact maintenance are separate operations.

cases.question: Create a frequent flyer membership for me and request a vegetarian special meal.
cases.rationale: Loyalty enrollment and dietary meal accommodation require distinct routes.

cases.question: Calculate what my monthly mortgage repayment would be at a lower interest rate.
cases.rationale: A mortgage repayment calculation is outside the airline catalog.

cases.question: Tell me how to repair a television that has sound but no picture.
cases.rationale: Home television repair has no airline-catalog operation.

cases.question: Transfer this chat to a live airline service representative, please.
cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests human assistance, which is labeled handoff with no intent ID.

cases.question: I would like to speak with an actual person from the airline support team now.
cases.rationale: The sole requested action is a human-support transfer.

cases.question: Only the return leg; keep the outbound flight as it is.

messages.content: I need to cancel something in my paid return-flight reservation.
Should the whole reservation be cancelled, or only one part of it?

cases.rationale: The clarification reply selects cancellation of only one segment of the paid reservation.

cases.question: Stop that cancellation request; I will keep both flights.

messages.content: Only the return leg; keep the outbound flight as it is.
Your request concerns the return leg. No cancellation has been carried out.

cases.question: On the trip I am keeping, put me in an aisle seat.

messages.content: Stop that cancellation request; I will keep both flights.
The cancellation request has been stopped; your flights are unchanged.

cases.rationale: After abandoning cancellation, the user introduces a seat-assignment request.

cases.question: Please let a live agent take over arranging this seat.

messages.content: On the trip I am keeping, put me in an aisle seat.
I can help with a seat assignment on the existing trip.

cases.rationale: An explicit human handoff supersedes the current seat-selection flow.

cases.question: The bag's whereabouts, not a reimbursement.

cases.question: Stop searching for the suitcase for now.

messages.content: The bag's whereabouts, not a reimbursement.
I can help check the location using your existing tracing report.

cases.rationale: The user abandons the active location lookup without requesting closure of the underlying baggage report.

messages.content: Stop searching for the suitcase for now.
The lookup has been stopped.
The courier has now brought the suitcase.

messages.content: The handle is snapped off; I want to report the damage.
I can help report the damage to the returned bag.

cases.rationale: The explicit topic switch requests reservation-contact maintenance rather than a reply within baggage reporting.

messages.content: Find me a replacement flight; I still need to travel.

messages.content: What reason did the airline give for cancelling that flight?
I can help find the reported cause of the flight cancellation.

cases.rationale: The user explicitly requests a person to handle the explanation, so the decision is handoff.
